q: 每个发货仓昨天发了多少单？

    w.warehouse AS "发货仓",
    COUNT(*) AS "单量"
FROM 
    biz_order o

    store s ON s.id = o.store_id

    (SELECT '上海嘉定常温仓' AS warehouse UNION ALL
     SELECT '上海青浦冷链仓' UNION ALL

WHERE 
    NOT o.is_test
    AND o.shipped_at >= '2026-10-24'::date
    AND o.shipped_at < '2026-10-25'::date
GROUP BY 
    w.warehouse
